comments.text: This dam is not the Imhwa Dam on the Nakdong River in Gyeongsang Province, but a peace dam built by President Chun Doo-hwan in Hwacheon. This dam was built to protect South Korea during floods in North Korea. It is a dam located in Hwacheon, Gangwon Province. This video is incorrect. The location and place name do not match.

replies.author: @VagariousTravel-868
replies.text:
Thanks for your comment and for pointing this out. I think there might be a small misunderstanding here. The video actually covers two separate dams at different points:

The Imha Dam (5:04 - 7:57) – located in Andong, Gyeongsangbuk-do, on the Banbyeoncheon River. This is a multi-purpose dam for water supply and flood control.

The Peace Dam (22:30 - 25:31) – located in Hwacheon, Gangwon-do. This is the one built under President Chun Doo-hwan in the 1980s as a defense against potential flooding from North Korea's Imnam Dam upstream.

So both dams are included in the video, but they appear in separate sections. I can see how the transition between them might have caused some confusion. The information about the Peace Dam being a defensive structure built in Hwacheon during the Chun Doo-hwan administration is historically accurate.

Appreciate you watching closely and bringing this up—it helps make the content better. Let me know if you have any other questions!
